producerScope: Actual unmodified Node-exact production replay. NOT a browser-reference positive replay and NOT cross-engine original-ray equality.

limits: Exact numerical layout only: no packet/source reduction, implicit pair allowance or frame-time admission.
For nonempty active-count output, texels beyond metadata.count may retain old values and are not valid reads.
Zero count or zero density requires one fresh full allocated neutral-output pass; no previous texture may substitute for that pass.

rectangles.borrowedOutputPolicy: Synchronous complete prepare; draw matching ordered view before any next prepare replaces its borrowed output
rectangles.scope: Exact viewport geometry and conservative64-slot work only; no complete-request policy, allocation, aggregate frame, GL or numerical admission

views.scope: CPU complete source projection/ray capture only; diagnostic GPU label is inert acknowledgement, never an actual backend result
